chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Hariz, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), said:

He was asked about the son of the raped woman, when a man fabricates against her and says, 'O son of the doer (of fornication),' so he said: 'I view that upon him is the Hadd (penalty) of eighty lashes, and he should repent to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, from what he said.'
ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for slandering a woman by calling her son illegitimate?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific Hadd penalty for *Li'an*-adjacent slander where a man accuses a woman of fornication by calling her son 'son of the doer' (*Ibn al-Fa'ila*). Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the standard punishment of eighty lashes, emphasizing that the offender must also perform *Tawbah* (repentance) to Allah for the verbal transgression, highlighting the intersection of judicial penalty and spiritual accountability in Shia jurisprudence. This ruling is foundational in understanding how verbal defamation against women is treated within the broader framework of *Hudud* laws.
